competition.name: Open Source Higgsfield
competition.scope: Build an open-source creative application using ComfyUI, inspired by Higgsfield applications or an original idea.

deadline_discrepancy.outdated_listing: The NYC Luma page retains October 30 at 9 AM Pacific as the online deadline and mentions an event-day opportunity for attendees.
deadline_discrepancy.current_confirmation: The official competition page and submission form both show the extension to November 3 at 9 AM Pacific / noon Eastern.

sourced_rules.additional_tools_and_models: Allowed when explained in the demo video.

feature_permission_on_submission.description: Submission includes agreement to credited promotion, including Comfy sites and products, under the form's Creator Feature Terms.

sourced_rules.open_weights_category: Requires open-weights models and no closed model APIs or partner nodes. The submission form says rented GPUs still count as fully open.

submission_checklist.content: Show the working application and explain how it was built; explain innovation when entering that category.
Link the demonstration on a social platform such as Reddit, X, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, or TikTok.

submission_checklist.judging_notes: The form says this link will remain private to judges, expects approximately 5–10 judging runs, and permits rate limits or spending caps.

submission_checklist.item: Complete the official submission form before the deadline

required: Fully open stack: yes, no, or unsure
agreements: Public repository with an open-source license
Lawful, SFW content with permitted IP and likenesses
Credited feature permission under the referenced terms
This is the entrant's only submission

main.eligibility: Novel application, custom nodes, or use of ComfyUI; explain the innovation in the demo.
Enjoyable to use and suited to sharing.
Open-weights models without partner nodes or closed model APIs.

provider_bonuses.eligibility: LTX is the workflow's core video model.
FLUX 3 is the workflow's core model.
MiniMax H3 is the workflow's core model.

nyc_build_night.title: Open Source Higgsfield: ComfyUI Build Night

agenda.activity: Structured building with Comfy team support

mac_desktop.installation_flow: Download the official DMG, copy Comfy Desktop into Applications, launch it, and create a ComfyUI instance.

sdk.cloud_api_note: The documentation states that Comfy Cloud API access requires a paid subscription.
sdk.self_hosted_v2_note: The v2 SDK connects to a self-hosted ComfyUI through the separate comfy-api-proxy service.

technical_context.workflow_basics: Load a template or workflow JSON, download its missing models, then run it. ComfyUI-generated images can also carry importable workflow metadata.

suggested_next_steps.status: Suggestions for planning; these are not organizer rules.
items: Choose one narrow creative interaction and a target prize category.
Confirm the relevant workflow runs before adding application controls.
Keep model, node, and setup requirements documented as the project develops.
Budget time for the repository instructions, two-minute demo, social post, and submission form.
Use local inference or an explicitly selected hosted backend according to the workflow's hardware needs.
